Cliff sets

Continuous landforms using the river's 16 corner patterns and three undulating contours. Drag to orbit.

Climbable ledge · level soil cap and clear landingImpassable crag · sloping crest, no climbing route

The flat top and highest crag crests reach wall height: 2 world units. Crags meet ledges at the same height, then slope down toward their exposed edges. Sand fades into the selected grass colour on the same continuous surface. Each family includes 16 river-compatible corner patterns × 3 contour variants. This is an art study; editor placement and gameplay traversal are awaiting integration.
